cache_regime: sequential paired arms with shared key; balanced AB/BA; provider cache is not controlled
limitations: controlled mutations, not historical issues or a random repository sample
local contract checks, not full upstream regression suites
cache state uncontrolled; order balanced within each task
concurrent timing is secondary; tokens do not establish monetary cost
primary: repository mean of four paired log token ratios; equal repository weights
published_scope: Numerical aggregate projection of retained private evidence; causal/raw telemetry authenticity and provider billing are outside this projection.

reproduction_recipe.clusters: For each repo mean log(inline_tokens/baseline_tokens) over four paired observations; weight the 12 repo means equally.
reproduction_recipe.decision: Strict saving and quality gates must BOTH pass; assumptions in statistics remain required.
reproduction_recipe.quality_e: product(1 + mean(inline_accepted-baseline_accepted) within repo + 0.05) across 12 repo clusters; threshold20.
reproduction_recipe.requests: Sum request_count within each mode, including unsuccessful attempts.
reproduction_recipe.token_upper95: exp(mean(repo_log_means) + t95_one_sided * sample_sd(repo_log_means) / sqrt(12)); critical value is frozen in saving_gate.
reproduction_recipe.tokens: Sum input_tokens + output_tokens for all records within each mode; cached input is a subset of input, never added again.

scope: 24 predefined single-defect Python repairs in 12 pinned real source trees; gpt-6-luna low

assumptions: approximate Student t interval for repository log means
bounded acceptance differences; e-product tests average difference <= -0.05

study_kind: development; predefined controlled single-defect Python repairs
timing_scope: secondary; four concurrent pairs, excludes install/preflight/grading
